data.about:
With over 24 years of experience, I have effectively managed large software engineering and R&D teams. I am deeply passionate about using technology to solve complex problems and fostering highly agile, customer-centric, innovative, and motivated teams. I strive to establish high-performance engineering culture, delivering engineering excellence, technical vision, and direction. I am strongly dedicated to people leadership and endeavor to assist them in achieving their goals through coaching, guidance, feedback, recognition, and creating an environment of openness, honesty, transparency, compassion, and teamwork.

In my previous roles, I have successfully led large software development teams with over 100 members. The software developed by these teams has been deployed in telecommunications companies worldwide. Additionally, I have overseen the development of multiple enterprise products. I have also led multiple product development teams concurrently and have been recognized with several awards for engineering excellence. 

My expertise includes system architecture and design, software version planning, Agile execution, quality management, budget and headcount management, recruitment, people management, training, performance and feedback management, coaching, internal and external stakeholder management, escalation management, and reporting. I possess strong skills in customer and cross-functional stakeholder management, collaboration, and negotiation.

Having delivered numerous complex projects involving multiple countries and vendors, my background also includes experience in project management, program management, and system integration. I offer a unique perspective that encompasses the entire life cycle of software development, from requirement to installation and launch. My extensive knowledge of project and program management covers supply chain, procurement, vendor and stakeholder management, as well as risk and escalation management

description.text:
Product Engineering & customization Leader :  Digtial in cloud & Microservices (Team size : 70+]
	Development, customization and maintenance of 5+ Digital cloud product. Products include digital-in-cloud VAS product, proxies and protocol gateways.  Versions delivered to 50+ operators and 250+ installations globally. 
	Development and customization and maintenance of 4+ microservices products used internally within the GTS department for project critical services such as resource management, project technical management, cost settlement and project management. 
	Define and execute department KPI related to buisness, people management and operations. 
	Accountable for scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, issue, stakeholder, team management and ensure high version quality, cybersecurity and manage issues/escalations.  
	Team management (recruitment, capability, cost, performance, team building, customer feedback, vendor &contract staff management etc.), 
	Drive the AGILE and CI/CD, Devops goals. 

Leader : Deployment/Delivery Team & TMO(Technical Management Office) [Team size : 150+]
	Accountability of 10+ products and 300+ projects delivered across the globe 
	Responsibilities include E2E delivery (both onsite and offshore), revenue assurance, schedule, cost, quality, issue, resource management, team, vendor management and cyber security compliance. 
	As TMO head, lead cross functional teams such as Customer & frontline teams, SA, Technical Directors, R&D team, PMO and ensure E2E project success.  
	Motivate and direct the project team; set goals, objectives and priorities; assign and review project tasks and performance on a regular basis, bench marking against key milestone deliverables.
	Personally delivered 5+ projects as Project/program Manager for large multi-country deployment projects with geographically distributed, cross-cultural teams and multi-vendor engagements.

	Responsible for the globaly version delivery of 5+ products. Products deployed in 30+ operators globally. 
	Technical manager & design architect of IMS/LTE Diameter and SIP suite including diameter base protocol stack and various interfaces such as Gq, Rf, Ro, etc. product received excellent reviews from the IMS interoperability meet at Chicago USA, 2007. 
	Responsible for project planning scope, schedule, cost, quality (CMMi &Tl9000 compliance), risk, issue, stakeholder, team management and ensure high version quality and manage escalations. 
	Lead programmer and individual contributor for IP Security gateway (Netrake Corp, Dallas, Texas, USA). Design and development of features in IKE/IPSEC stack such as multi-cert, SA-Flush etc.
	Technical lead for IRG gateway product which enable GSM to CDMA roaming.

description.text:
• Protocol stack development lead
-	ITU , ETSI and TEC SS7 standard compliance. Inter-operability implementation with C-DOT switch.  Incorporated missing features to the stack and rectified deviations at the MTP3, SCCP,  TCAP and MAP layers. 
•	Design and enhancement for MTP3 link failure handling, Error Management, ISUP call state machines and routing engine. 
•	Design and development of the supplementary services such as call forwarding, multi-call conferencing, collect call, call barring, AOI, Incoming collect call etc.
•	IN related features development for event arming, IDP state machines. 
•	Version releases to multiple sites such as Mali, Trinidad, Togo, and Honduras etc.

•	Founding member of in-house software development and R&D team.
•	Design and development of various SS7 based roaming applications such as welcome Roamer,  Preferred roaming enabler platform etc. Developed location based services, call conferencing, critical process monitoring and self rectification platform for MSC call recording, mediation, rating and billing process failures. 
•	SMSC, USSD, IVR, WAP and LBS based value added applications such as tariff change, service subscription, balance query, currency recharge and lifecycle management, juke box, greeting server, multi-party conferencing etc. porting products from R2MF to SS7 protocol . 
•	Implementation of IN features such as collect call, mid call barring, call forwarding etc.
